timing: Query embedding measured once per question after warmup, reported separately. estimated_total_ms = embed_ms + backend_ms. CPU/RSS are Python CLIENT ONLY; Neo4j/Qdrant Docker resource use is NOT measured here.
limitations: Gold is manually reviewed against same frozen corpus; not independent external clinical validation.
Graph filters are supplied as structured benchmark metadata; free-text constraint extraction is NOT evaluated.
Graph-only cannot answer semantic_unconstrained questions by design; excluded, not scored zero.
Hybrid uses vector-only fallback for eight semantic questions, not an independent gain.
A single underlying medical fact may appear in multiple benchmark questions (correlated cases).
Measured performance in this small 25-drug corpus does not generalize to clinical usage.
Recall@k is recall against the judged CORPUS relevance set, not real-world drug completeness.
Client CPU/RSS excludes Docker containers; collect docker stats separately for full infrastructure CPU/RAM.
